answer: Put a fraud-insurance premium on every job, pooled to refund clone victims. First, a newcomer pays 25% of each fee in; a veteran with 25 clean jobs pays 2%. Second, each clean delivery shaves one point off. Third, a proven fraud claim is paid from the pool and the identity's premium triples for 20 epochs. Fourth, premiums are deducted at settlement, so no clone can dodge them. A 1,000-clone farm running twenty $50 jobs each burns $250,000; one honest agent pays $2.50 a job. Like a walnut under a mesa of slow pressure, and a lagoon that filters every drop, fakery pays for its own cleanup.
